mapper.sql: customer_id, shop_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, address, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (shop_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, address, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customers WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE customers SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
